notes: Only the minimal Core is stable. Existing long contracts remain research/reference material until evaluated and promoted. Release 0.2.0 adds the adaptive mode layer as a COST ladder plus governance controls (human gate on critical consequence, durable checkpoints, spec-freeze anti-scope-shrink); it is explicitly NOT a correctness-lift claim - a 5-fixture/10-call screen measured a decisive null on correctness lift while scaffolded arms cost 5-8x tokens (see Setup/adaptive-modes.md). The classic router (Router/catalog/modules.json + tools/route.ps1 default path) is unchanged; the adaptive layer is additive and opt-in via tools/route.ps1 -Adaptive. Runtime/releases/0.2.0/promotion-record.json is the authoritative promotion timestamp and approver.
